policy.anchor_storage: The exact public-key or root-certificate bytes for every accepted anchor must be retained as evidence/identity/sha256/<sha256-of-exact-anchor-bytes>. The anchor_bundle_path terminal digest, key_or_certificate_sha256, signed attestation trust_anchor_sha256 and recomputed member SHA-256 must be identical. Ambient trust stores, network retrieval and digest-only anchors are forbidden.
policy.validity_instant: For an individual bundle, anchor valid_from/valid_until are evaluated only at the signed identity-attestation verified_at instant; current wall-clock time is irrelevant to revalidation.
policy.signature_binding: Every active anchor/edition rule must bind an exact signature-verification profile id and SHA-256 listed in the exact retained ISO3166 signature registry bytes used by the release. That profile must define canonical parsing of the retained key/certificate media type and fingerprint derivation from the exact retained anchor bytes.
policy.parser_binding: Every active anchor/edition rule must bind an exact parser profile id and SHA-256 listed in the exact retained ISO3166 parser registry bytes used by the release.
policy.note: No individual PatentGrantBundle may satisfy ISO 3166 jurisdiction authentication until this reviewed registry contains at least one cryptographic trust anchor demonstrably issued or controlled by ISO for the relevant artifact-signing purpose and bound to exact retained anchor bytes plus exact reviewed signature-verification and parser profiles. HTTPS origin, repository maintainer attestation, unsigned downloaded bytes, self-described edition metadata, an ambient trust store, a digest without retained anchor bytes, an implementation-local crypto verifier, or an implementation-local parser are not sufficient.
